title: KING STREET ELEVATION

texts.text: This is a detailed line drawing of the southwest elevation of the Iolani Palace in Honolulu, Hawaii, created for the Historic American Buildings Survey. The architectural style is ornate and historic, featuring multiple stories with arched windows, decorative balustrades, prominent towers at the corners, and a central tower structure above the main entrance. The drawing includes precise dimensional annotations indicating measurements in feet for various parts of the facade.
WESTERN OFFICE - NATIONAL PARK SERVICE AND DEPT OF ACCT. & GEN. SERV. & STATE OF HAWAII UNDER DIRECTION OF THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE. UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR
